output.explanation: NIG-US line NIG-US:4471151 invoices a Oct-26 management fee of 71,000 USD (INV-US-100343), while NIG-SA line NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019052 books 56,800 USD described as net of 20% WHT. The buyer-to-seller ratio of 0.8 and the 14,200 USD difference (exactly 20% of 71,000) match the Saudi management-fee withholding rate, and the invoice reference is found on the buyer line.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to 71,000 USD and record the 14,200 USD withholding as a WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority, with the WHT certificate retained for NIG-US.
output.adjustment_description: Increase NIG-SA IC payable by 14,200 USD to the gross invoice amount of 71,000 USD, and credit a WHT payable of 14,200 USD (Dr management fee expense or IC payable, Cr WHT payable).
